text:
ITEM 1 | Two small florets with a fibrous, bumpy green surface and tree-like branching stems, bright green with slightly darker crevices, dry matte surface with no visible sheen, sitting together on the left side of the white plate, roughly 4 cm and 5 cm across, about 3 cm tall | 45
ITEM 2 | Single larger floret cluster with dense, bumpy dark-to-medium green head and pale green stem, matte and dry, touching the first florets at the lower left of the plate, roughly 5 cm across and 3 cm tall | 50
ITEM 3 | Wedge-shaped slice about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, with a pale cheese-white base partly browned and spotted golden-brown at the edges, topped with irregular red tomato sauce patches that look slightly glossy and moist, sitting on the right side of the plate; the crust edge is firm and bubbly-looking with light char spots | 120
